purpose: Attribute thin native1x v2-v5 GPU time without changing shipping code, CPU culling, painter order, camera geometry, attachment size or timing counter semantics.

same_attachment_contract.format: same resolved target format as bound actualApp native1x run
same_attachment_contract.load_store: same LoadOp::Load/StoreOp::Store semantics and original clear/output outside tiny-view loop
same_attachment_contract.camera_order: retain full actual camera list and indices 0..17; only v2-v5 controls vary
same_attachment_contract.timing: GpuTimer labels/counters unchanged; report pass durations and increments separately; never sum p50s or call increments shader cost

controlled_axes.matrix: 4x4 free/text matrix with glyph cache on, then text axis with cache off; v0/v1 and other cameras full UI/world; only diagnostic packet metadata/category masks vary for v2-v5; no renderer/shader/timing/culling source changes

arm_encoding.free_axis: Per-instance category masks make existing free_vs GPU wrong-category culls run while ranges remain populated. Preserve all records/order. If host coarse filtering skips a range, invalidate that arm and use contiguous ALL_VIEWS range with per-instance category masks.
arm_encoding.text_axis: Stable source-index prefixes of same glyph list, nonempty sentinel, original font/outlines; record metadata bytes and draw instance range.
arm_encoding.glyph_cache_axis: Separate untimed cache enabled/disabled controls; record fill/publish jobs, metadata bytes, ready-tag epoch; fresh process after reset/atlas replacement.
arm_encoding.controls: Prepare each immutable arm once and upload once; repeated frames update camera/control tick only; no CPU per-frame culling/repacking.

required_measurements.per_frame: GPU frame span, v0/v1, v2/v3/v4/v5, increments separately, clear/output/glyph-fill/publish, inter-frame gap; CPU host encode and worker draw separately; p50/p95/p99/max per complete window.
required_measurements.counters: Submitted/collected samples, drops, timer epoch, full submissions/reuse/replay, source counts, v2-v5 free/text ranges, metadata bytes, cache jobs/hits/entries/reset epoch.
required_measurements.GPU_side: If AMD Vulkan tooling exposes pipeline statistics, record vertex/primitive/fragment invocations per pass. Otherwise unavailable; do not infer from elapsed spans.
required_measurements.host_load: Retain AMD busy/clock/power and CPU/memory/IO pressure; not a quiet hardware limit.

interpretation.attachment_only: Constant ~1.2ms with zero free/text and zero glyph metadata implicates render-pass/attachment/barrier cost; use same Load/Store zero-draw control.
interpretation.free_text_scaling: Monotonic timing with GPU-visible eligible count at fixed target points to vertex/fragment work; separate cache and metadata axes.
interpretation.metadata_only: Constant draw range with different metadata/cache timing points to metadata reads/fill; host upload remains separate.
interpretation.no_causality: If controls do not move timing, retain no isolated cause; do not patch from source inspection.

correctness_requirements: Preserve camera IDs, shifts, world xy, clips, binding, painter order, category rules and full v0/v1 UI.
Full-scene off/on pixel/content check remains separate before adoption.
No CPU culling, locks, waits, shader edits, timing changes or attachment resizing.
Do not delete filler cameras or merge views.
Any order/content/timer/validation/adapter failure invalidates the arm.
execution_gates: Separate AMD-only GPU broker lease explicitly granted after priority audio/deploy work.
Fresh private diagnostic run; release GPU immediately; no VM/Neo/shipping operation.
Preserve raw logs/all failures; approved binary-cell package immutable.
not_ready_reasons: No diagnostic build or run started.

cache_safety.source_constraint: glyph_cache State.submitted reset clears CPU entries/shelves but GPU ready buffer tags are not globally cleared; stale ready tags can alias after rectangle reuse.
cache_safety.diagnostic_rule: Never reuse a glyph-cache process across atlas/layout reset, source replacement or cache-size change. Run each cache arm in a fresh process and record ready-tag epoch, reset count, atlas generation and entry count.
cache_safety.reuse_candidate_constraint: A future shared metadata mapping must carry an explicit atlas/layout epoch or clear/invalidate GPU readiness before rectangle reuse. Camera-only changes cannot by themselves prove safe reuse when metadata visibility depends on view/category/clip/viewport.

execution_blockers: AMD-only GPU broker lease not granted
No diagnostic build or GPU run allowed yet
Root post-build review remains the gate before execution
